_notice: Fictional example bank policies for the legacy demo and its tests. Not a real bank.

policies.refunds: Refunds are returned to the original payment method within five business days once approved.
policies.lost_card: Report a lost or stolen card immediately; a replacement is posted within three business days.
policies.disputes: Disputed transactions are reviewed within ten business days; provisional credit may apply.
policies.overdraft: Accounts do not offer an overdraft facility; a declined payment is not charged.
policies.international_use: Cards work abroad; the foreign transaction fee depends on the card type.
